question: How many people in my organisation are currently not on leave?
correct_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT eps.assoc_id) AS not_on_leave_n FROM hr.emp_period_snapshot eps JOIN hr.pay_period_dim pp ON pp.ppe_dt = eps.period_end_dt AND pp.freq_cd = 'B' WHERE pp.is_current_flag AND eps.snap_dt = eps.period_end_dt AND eps.status_cd IS DISTINCT FROM 'L' AND {manager_id} IN (eps.lvl_2_id, eps.lvl_3_id, eps.lvl_4_id, eps.lvl_5_id, eps.lvl_6_id, eps.lvl_7_id, eps.lvl_2_id_fn, eps.lvl_3_id_fn, eps.lvl_4_id_fn, eps.lvl_5_id_fn, eps.lvl_6_id_fn, eps.lvl_7_id_fn)
